features.label: Custom trimmable foot plate
features.text: The thin, flexible polypropylene base can be quickly trimmed with standard household scissors for a precision fit to your unique foot shape without requiring a heat gun or special tools.

features.label: Heel-less comfort design
features.text: An innovative open heel construction eliminates bulky plastic at the back of the foot, significantly improving walking comfort while fitting seamlessly into most standard athletic and dress shoes.

features.label: Dynamic leaf spring lift
features.text: The semi-rigid injection-molded posterior mechanism resists plantar flexion to provide critical toe clearance during the swing phase of gait, preventing tripping and promoting natural walking mechanics.

features.label: Lightweight anatomical frame
features.text: Variable thickness throughout the polypropylene upright delivers maximum structural strength exactly where needed while keeping the overall orthosis weight incredibly low for extended daily wear.

features.label: Adjustable calf support
features.text: A secure hook-and-loop calf strap fastens the orthosis firmly to the lower leg, allowing you to easily fine-tune stabilization and prevent shifting during active movement.

features.label: Pdac approved l1930
features.text: Verified prefabricated ankle foot orthosis made from rigid plastic materials to provide essential alignment and customized support.

indications: Drop foot secondary to CVA (Cerebrovascular Accident / Stroke)

measurement: Size by US shoe size and specific side. Measure and choose corresponding size. The Small/Medium fits US shoe sizes 7.5 to 10.5 with a brace height of 10.75 in. The Large fits US shoe sizes 11 to 14 with a brace height of 12 in. The foot plate can be trimmed with scissors for a custom fit.
